provenance.notes: Extends the offence of disseminating intimate or sexual images without authorization (Ley 19.580 art. 92) to 'real or simulated' images, defined to include AI-generated plausible false representations. title: Ley N° 20.212 - Aprobación de Rendición de Cuentas y Balance de Ejecución Presupuestal. Ejercicio 2022
short_title: Uruguay 2022 Accountability Law (AI strategy and cybersecurity articles)

Cybersecurity: arts. 78-84 impose security and incident-reporting duties on public entities and private entities in critical sectors, AGESIC enforcement powers, and a national incident registry (regulated by Decreto 66/025).
